question: The Teacher describes a man who was all alone, with no son or brother. What was true about his toil?
options: There was no end to it, and he was never content with his wealth
He stopped working when he became rich
He gave everything he earned to the poor
He worked only for his king
explanation: There was no end to his toil, yet his eyes were not content with his wealth. He never asked who he was working for.
